title: Maintenance
description: Plan and start maintenance windows and end them after the safety checks have passed. Running data migrations and write fences cannot be bypassed here.

confirm.release: End maintenance now? The server checks the release conditions again.
confirm.start: Start maintenance now? hocX will be locked for users; running requests are completed first.

banner.fullActive: Full maintenance active: hocX is locked for all users. The admin portal stays reachable.
banner.partialActive: Partial maintenance active: some functions are locked.
banner.overdue: The estimated duration has been exceeded. The lock remains until the release conditions are met.

scheduled.title: Scheduled maintenance
scheduled.meta: Shown on the login page from now on
scheduled.metaBy: Shown on the login page from now on · scheduled by {email}

conditions.title: Safety checks before ending
conditions.blockedHint: Only possible once the release conditions are met

keys.storage_migration_settled: Data migration completed and verified, or source demonstrably still active and unchanged

reasons.cutover_open: A storage cutover is still open
reasons.migration_missing: The related migration was not found
reasons.integrity_not_confirmed: Final integrity check not yet confirmed
reasons.target_verified: New storage target verified and active
reasons.target_unverified: New storage target not yet verified
reasons.source_consistent: Previous storage still active and unchanged
reasons.inconsistent: Storage state is inconsistent – please check

form.messageHelp: Leave empty for the default text. Shown on the sign-in page.
form.startNow: Start now in a controlled way
form.endHelp: The end is only an announcement. Maintenance ends only when you end it after the checks have passed.

plan.title: Schedule maintenance
plan.description: Scheduled maintenance is announced on the sign-in page in advance and starts automatically at the chosen time.

idle.title: hocX is available as usual
idle.viewLogin: View the notice on the login page →

running.kicker: {state, select, preparing {Maintenance being prepared} verifying {Maintenance being verified} overdue {Maintenance overdue} other {Maintenance in progress}} · {kind}

kindDescription.full: hocX is unavailable, only the notice is shown.
kindDescription.writes: Reading stays possible, changes are blocked.
kindDescription.uploads: Everything stays usable, only uploads are blocked.

kindHint.full: During full maintenance hocX redirects all requests to the maintenance page. The admin portal stays available.
kindHint.writes: During a write lock hocX stays readable. Saving shows this notice.
kindHint.uploads: During an upload lock hocX stays usable. Uploads show this notice.
